item.title: Lawrence Humane Society takes in pets surrendered because owners fear deportation, detainment
item.description: The Lawrence Humane Society has taken in three dogs so far this year who were surrendered because their owners were afraid of detainment and deportation. The shelter had never documented cases like this before. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kaw Valley Almanac for Feb. 16-22, 2026
item.description: Here are the opened male blossoms of the silver maple, resting on tree bark. Some maples are male while others are female, and some have both types of flowers. Continue reading ...

item.title: The World Cup is the perfect place for disease to spread. Kansas health workers are preparing
item.description: A projected 650,000 people will visit the Kansas City region for the World Cup this year, and with that comes the risk of disease spreading and health care demands. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Transit On Demand to start charging per ride; here’s how to pay
item.description: Lawrence Transit will start charging $3 for each one-way on demand ride starting next month, and the city will only accept credit card payments. Continue reading ...

item.title: Multiple reports of ICE detainments, sightings in Lawrence; 5 arrests confirmed, advocates say
item.description: Lawrence was swept with reports of ICE sightings and arrests Tuesday. Advocates say they've confirmed five people were detained. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas cell phone ban applying to both public and private schools clears House
item.description: TOPEKA — Cell phones are one step closer to disappearing from Kansas classrooms after the House passed a bill that would require a daytime device ban to public and private schools. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Senate overturns governor’s veto of anti-trans ‘bathroom bill’
item.description: The Kansas Senate overturned Gov. Laura Kelly’s veto on Tuesday, putting the state one step closer to forcing people to use bathrooms in government buildings that match their biological sex at birth. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Mardi Gras parade draws energetic crowd
item.description: The Lawrence Mardi Gras parade drew a crowd of energetic and festive paradegoers who sang, danced and cheered their way through downtown Lawrence Tuesday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence police, Douglas County Sheriff say they had no notice ahead of ICE arrests
item.description: Spokespeople for the Lawrence Police Department and the Douglas County Sheriff's Office said that neither agency was involved in Tuesday's ICE sightings and arrests, nor did they know they were coming. Continue reading ...
